inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Start or retrieve an idempotent in-memory visual export.

seconds.description: Video length for webm only; png-sequence refuses a non-null value.

frames.description: png-sequence only: frame count N; frame i is rendered from the stored view state for index i of N (orbit/deformation phase i/N, time/slice phase i/(N-1)); time requires N <= stored acoustic or thermal temperature snapshots; thermal needs the temperature field.

view.description: Optional JSON request context retained for idempotency. The live renderer captures its current scene; this field does not apply a requested view. Use setResultView before exporting.

sideEffects: Starts renderer work and retains an in-memory PNG/WebM/PNG-sequence (STORE ZIP with manifest.json) artifact; does not download or persist files.
limitations: Argument envelope only; runtime validation remains authoritative.

Single-view WebM animation time supports acousticTransient/instantPressure only through singleTimeWebmExport capability. It uses VP8 fixed N=min(seconds*24,120), a fixed camera, nearest stored physical frames from first through last with requested/actual/signed-offset ledger, and private encoder proof plus strict WebM/full decoding before publication. Capture fits 1280x640 and bytes stay <=32MiB. Unsupported codecs or incomplete endpoints refuse with no realtime fallback. Preview and other WebM animations retain existing realtime semantics; thermal time remains PNG sequence only.
Nonblank requestId; same request identity/content reuses a retained job.

Thermal time export is PNG-sequence only with stored temperature frames and no interpolation; real-time/WebM time playback remains acoustic-only. Default retention four jobs / 32 MiB; WebM depends on browser support; orbit/deformation/slice remain realtime. Fixed acoustic time frames are saved visualization states, not physical time integration. png-sequence is fixed-frame and wall-clock independent: frames 2-120, at most 4 MiB per frame and 24 MiB per archive (explicit refusals), manifest.json holds per-frame result revision, phase/angle/time/slice position, resolution and SHA-256; cancel discards the archive and restores controls.
